To continue, check the box to accept.

To see %1$s’s marks on top of your screen, allow Nibbletec Assist to display over other apps. Android will open a setting: turn the switch on and come back here.
Android will ask you to confirm. If it asks what to share, choose “Entire screen” so %1$s can follow you between apps.
Nothing was shared. You can try again whenever you’re ready.
Your screen couldn’t be shared. Try again.
Sharing. %1$s will see your screen as soon as they connect.
You can leave this app and use your phone normally. %1$s will see what you do and guide you.
%1$s’s marks appear on top of your screen.
